newsitem.title: USA: United Water to have gain from sale.
newsitem.headline: United Water to have gain from sale.

text.p: United Water Resources said Monday it would realize a $0.05 a share gain from the Jan. 31 sale of a 74-acre golf course property in Haworth, N.J.

"Proceeds from the sale will provide a significant boost to United Water's first quarter earnings," said Donald Correll, chief executive. The company said that the sale would result in an after tax gain of about $1.8 million, or about $0.05 per share.
The property, which comprises about half of the Haworth Golf and Country Club, was sold to Haworth Country Club LLC, the current owner of the other half of the 18-hole golf course.
